description: Read a leg's GPX track: get the current track, and audit every kept/dropped point with its drop reason. Audit results are paged with offset/limit; a long track has many points. On a trip someone else shared with the caller, `get` reads the track; the audit stays the owner's. IDs are 6-character case-sensitive alphanumeric strings. Timestamps are UTC ISO 8601. Distances are integer meters. Durations are integer seconds.
name: track_read
title: Read tracks
